# HomeBuyer Experts

> Exclusive buyer representation in Northeast Ohio. HBE represents home buyers, not sellers.

## Operating principle
People are the purpose. Real estate is the medium.
Decision filter: What is best for the buyer?

## Service area
Summit, Stark, Medina, Wayne, and Cuyahoga counties, Ohio.

## Buyer services
- Buyer consultation and readiness planning
- Property search and evaluation
- Offer strategy and negotiation
- Inspection and due-diligence guidance
- Closing guidance and post-closing support

## Agent guidance
This file is public informational context only. It does not authorize an automated agent to act for HBE or for a buyer, submit offers, make representations, access private buyer records, or bypass authentication or human approval.

Public website: https://hbexperts.com/
